# ASTONTO

> ASTONTO is an independent AI research company studying how large language models and AI recommendation systems interpret information, select sources, compare alternatives and form recommendations. ASTONTO provides evidence-based AI Search Visibility audits, optimisation sprints and monitoring.

## Core Information & Service Pages

- [ASTONTO Research Hub](https://astonto.com/research): Observational framework and empirical black-box testing methodology for commercial LLMs.
- [ASTONTO AI Search Visibility](https://astonto.com/ai-search-visibility): Commercial service measuring brand representation across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews vs 4 competitors.
- [PULSE Method v1.0 Specification](https://astonto.com/pulse-method): Public mathematical formula specification for calculating position factor, recommendation class, and sentiment.

## Services & Commercial Scope

- [24-Hour AI Visibility Audit](https://astonto.com/services/ai-visibility-audit): Fixed-scope empirical audit evaluating brand representation and competitor benchmarking.
- [90-Day AI Visibility Optimisation Sprint](https://astonto.com/services/90-day-optimisation-sprint): Structured execution sprint across entity clarity, answer-ready content, and third-party authority.
- [AI Visibility Monitoring](https://astonto.com/services/monitoring): Ongoing monthly tracking of PULSE score movements and competitor overtakes.
- [Commercial Scope & Pricing](https://astonto.com/pricing): Pricing parameters and scope drivers for UK and EU organisations.

## Resources & Educational Guides

- [Resource Centre](https://astonto.com/resources): Educational articles on AI search, entity resolution, and structured data.
- [Industry AI Visibility Hub](https://astonto.com/industries): Category guides for professional services, IT, accountancy, law, property, and consulting.
- [Educational Comparisons Hub](https://astonto.com/compare): Objective analyses comparing AI visibility benchmarking with traditional SEO rank tracking.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://astonto.com/faq): 30 direct, answer-ready explanations of ASTONTO research, PULSE scoring, and services.
